result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Administrative Code) covering city purchasing, Police Department and Finance Department/Chief Financial Officer provisions, with no residential rental rules.
result.notes: This part contains only sections 22.0518 through 22.0710 of the San Diego Municipal Code (polystyrene foam purchasing, Police Department duties, unclaimed property, Chief Financial Officer and Finance Department duties, financial reporting and certifications). None concern rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The source URL and page title suggest the target algorithmic rent-setting provision (Division 11, section 98.1103) exists elsewhere in the document, but its text is not in this part, so no rule is extracted.
